NIBSDescription: Single-pulse TMS over left M1 or left SMG during rest or the pegboard task, at 7 TMS intensities
TaskDescription: completing the grooved pegboard with the right hand, rest the left hand
Instructions: take pegs and place them in the holes, or move pegs from hole to hole with your right hand only; don't move quickly, just keep moving steadily so that you're always moving your hand
